title: 第十章 收获与再入第一章 一份普通的工作
content_zh:
半天后，市内某医院。
——面前的医生正一撮一撮地往下薅着头发。
十分用力地在薅。
为了防止他那本身就不高的发际线再缩短一点，周游好心出言提醒道：“那个，大夫，我这病情....怎么样了？”
“病情？啊对了，病情！”医生连忙将手中的CT放到一边，然后说道：“周先生，您这病情.....简直就是奇迹啊！我们原本以最乐观的估计来算，您大概也只有两个月寿命了，但现在这病灶居然稳定下来了！虽然对您脑部的影响仍未消失，但你至少可以再支撑一段时间......”
剩下的话周游并没有去听，他仅是背靠上椅子，整个躯体倏然放松了下来。
——原来，不是梦啊。
.......................................................
告别了那个十分热情想让他再住一次院的医生，周游回到了自己的家里。
说是家，其实也只是一个狭小破败的出租屋，除了干净些以外，整体环境比那栋鬼楼都不遑多让——甚至某些基建设施还要更差一些。
这也很正常，毕竟归根结底他没钱。
他的祖父，也就是前不久刚过世的老周头并不富裕，供他上完大学已经十分勉强了，本来他是打算工作后赚一些补贴家用的，谁想到老头却因为一场意外去世，葬礼之类的事情已经又消耗了不少积蓄，之后检查出来的绝症更是成了压垮他的最后一根稻草。
用更简单点的方式来形容的话，就是在进入这个游戏之前，周游便已经近乎到山穷水尽的地步了。
“——不过所幸的是，到了现在总算有一些转机了。”
周游擦干净灵檀上的黑白遗像，然后看着那张面容苍老，然而却不怒自威的面容，忽然笑着说道。
“老头子，我也不知道这本书是不是你特意留给我的，但多亏这玩意，你可怜的孙子总算可以磕磕绊绊地活下去了——也暂时没法去看你了，不过以你的性格来讲，肯定也不怎么想这么快见到我就是了......”
周游摇摇头，又十分珍重地重新将遗像摆正，接着才坐回到一边的木桌旁，翻找了一会，然后从抽屉的角落中拿出了一本书。
也正是那本黑色封皮，带他进入那个“诡诞游戏”的旧书。
如今上面已经看不到任何痕迹，书页间也皆是一片空白，看起来就是一本普普通通的老旧物件，但就在周游将手按在上面的时候，他眼前突兀地浮现出几行文字。
“您已完成了新手副本：逃离四号楼。”

“您杀死了该副本的‘因由’：房东太太，并且利用连锁反应摧毁了构成怪谈的主体：尸门，您将获得额外的奖励。”
“您已获得了100+100（额外奖励）点魂石。”
“您现在保有的魂石数量为240。”
“您获得了一件特殊蓝色物品（杀死房东太太奖励升级）：铜制铃铛。”
“效果：使用时需挂在手腕上，当有‘某些东西’对你产生恶意时，这个铃铛有一定概率会飞速摇动以给你提出警示。”
“此物附带诅咒：当铃声响动时，偶尔也会惊扰敌人，并且暴露你的位置。”
《这是一件汽车上常见的装饰品，通常寓意为祈福，但在一次惨绝人寰并且全家死绝的车祸后，这个铃铛上已经沾染上了洗之不去的血迹。》
“您获得了一件未知品阶的特殊任务道具（杀死‘尸门’额外奖励）：门内的尸骨。”
content_en:
Half a day later, a hospital in the city.
——The doctor in front of him was pulling his hair down in bunches.
Pulling it together very hard.
In order to prevent his low hairline from shortening any further, Zhou You kindly reminded him: "Um, doctor, how is my condition...?"
"Sickness? Oh, yes, the condition!" The doctor quickly put aside the CT in his hand, and then said: "Mr. Zhou, your condition... is simply a miracle! We originally calculated based on the most optimistic estimate that you would only have two months to live, but now the disease has stabilized! Although the impact on your brain has not disappeared, you can at least support it for a while..."
Zhou You didn't listen to the rest of the words. He just leaned back on the chair and his whole body suddenly relaxed.
——It turns out that it was not a dream.
.................................................................
He said goodbye to the doctor who was very enthusiastic about letting him stay in the hospital again, and traveled back to his home.
It was said to be a home, but in fact it was just a small and dilapidated rental house. In addition to being cleaner, the overall environment was not much better than that of the ghost building - even some of the infrastructure was worse.
This is normal, after all, he has no money.
His grandfather, Lao Zhoutou, who had just passed away not long ago, was not wealthy and could barely support him through college. Originally, he planned to earn some money to support the family after working, but who would have thought that the old man died in an accident. Things like funerals had already consumed a lot of savings, and the terminal illness he was diagnosed with later became the last straw for him.
To describe it in a simpler way, before entering this game, traveling around is almost at the end of its rope.
"——But fortunately, things are finally turning around now."
Zhou You wiped off the black and white portrait on the coffin, then looked at the old but not angry face, and suddenly said with a smile.
"Old man, I don't know if you specially left this book for me, but thanks to this thing, your poor grandson can finally survive - and he can't see you for the time being, but considering your personality, you definitely don't want to see me so soon..."
Zhou You shook his head and carefully rearranged the portrait, then sat back at the wooden table on one side, rummaged for a while, and then took out a book from the corner of the drawer.
It was also the old book with a black cover that led him into that "weird game".
Now there are no traces on it, and the pages are all blank. It looks like an ordinary old book, but when Zhou You put his hand on it, a few lines of text suddenly appeared in front of his eyes.
"You have completed the novice copy: Escape from Building 4."
"You kill the 'cause' of this copy: the landlady, and use the chain reaction to destroy the main body of the ghost story: the corpse door. You will receive additional rewards."
"You have obtained 100+100 (extra reward) soul stones."
"The number of soul stones you currently have is 240."
"You have obtained a special blue item (reward upgrade for killing the landlady): a copper bell."
"Effect: It needs to be hung on the wrist when used. When 'something' is malicious to you, there is a certain probability that this bell will shake rapidly to give you a warning."
"This object comes with a curse: when the bell rings, it will occasionally disturb enemies and reveal your location."
"This is a common decoration on cars. It usually means praying for blessings. However, after a tragic car accident in which the entire family died, the bell was stainedThere were indelible blood stains on it. 》
"You have obtained a special mission item of unknown grade (additional reward for killing the 'Corpse Door'): the bones inside the door."
